[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC bob-cli-4s[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]bob highlights create --listen and every sase-listen target[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]`bob highlights create <TARGET>` accepts every document target that[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]`sase-listen render -e full` accepts (Markdown files, local PDFs, [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]PDF URLs, arXiv paper URLs, and web article URLs) and installs one [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]marker-stamped PDF into the Highlights intake. A PDF is stamped [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]as-is, never re-rendered. `--listen` runs the configured [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]`highlights.listen_command` (Bryan's chezmoi config sets [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]`sase-listen render {target} -e full -o {audio}`) with its output [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]streamed unchanged, and binds the published episode as the PDF's [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]companion audio. `bob highlights scan` then writes a ref note with [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]an audio player. When the target is already captured, `--listen` [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]attaches the new episode to the existing ref note instead. Every [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]article or paper Bryan listens to ends up tracked in his Obsidian [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]ref system. Nothing is ever written to the vault unless every step [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]succeeded.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]6[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]5[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]

[dim] Prompt: [#87AFFF][/dim]prompts/202610/highlights_create_listen.md[/#87AFFF]

[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Configurable listen command contract and runner[/bold #D7AFFF]               [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]listen-command[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]

    [#D7D7AF]template parser with shell-quoted {target}/{pdf}/{audio}/{title} [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]placeholders, a runner that streams output unchanged and verifies the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]MP3 written to {audio}, and a doctor row.[/#D7D7AF]

    [#D7D7AF]short-title stem rule, and a shared dedupe module with arXiv and legacy [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]url keys.[/#D7D7AF]

    [#D7D7AF]every route, CLI tests with a fake curl, and docs/highlights-create.md.[/#D7D7AF]

    [#D7D7AF]and record follow-ups.[/#D7D7AF]
